name: Ravi Kumar
headline: Building reliable backend systems & scalable APIs.
tagline: Backend Developer with 2+ years building the production PHP (Slim) backend of a real-estate CRM/ERP used by 200+ people daily, plus a Laravel REST API shipped with Docker, AWS and CI/CD.
intro: I'm Ravi Kumar, a Backend Developer specialising in PHP, Laravel, Slim and MySQL. I build production-ready REST APIs, business applications and third-party integrations, with a focus on performance, reliability and maintainability.
summary: I work on the parts of a product users never see but always depend on: lead pipelines, payment allocation, call routing, document generation and access control.

Day to day that means PHP (Slim and Laravel), MySQL tuned with window functions and transactions, Redis caching, and third-party integrations like Meta Lead Ads, Microsoft Graph and Exotel VoIP. Before this I taught PHP and MySQL to undergraduate students.
